description: Search the movahedi.ca public API by plain question, without guessing an endpoint. Use this when unsure which operation fits a question, for example 'has anyone been fined for facial recognition' or 'what does PIPEDA mean'. Returns matching operations with method, path, summary, parameters, use-when and do-not-use guidance, and one example REST query each, scored deterministically with no model call. Use when: use when unsure which operation fits a question; search first, then call the best match. Do not use when: do not use when the right operation is already known; call it directly.

query.description: Plain question about privacy data, up to 120 characters.
examples: has anyone been fined for facial recognition

name: privacy_search_api
title: Search the privacy API operations
